steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Grandpa Rat~!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Why are you out here all alone, little one? And your face is filthy. Were you crawling through air ducts again?

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Hehe, Uncle Ho gave this to me, Grandpa Rat! Uncle Ho said I'm small and I run fast, and if I got this to you quick enough he'd give me a yogurt. You have to tell him I did it!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Don't worry, Grandpa will tell him. Now you run along.

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Thanks, Grandpa! Bye byee~!

steps.name: Seemingly Ordinary Resident
steps.text: Something wrong, Uncle?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Do you recall those Siracusans who came looking for us some time ago? The rest of their 'Family' has since come to Lungmen.

steps.name: Seemingly Ordinary Resident
steps.text: Should I contact our spy?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: No need for that. Let us bide our time. They will come to us on their own.

steps.name: Seemingly Ordinary Resident
steps.text: What for?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: To survive in Lungmen.

steps.name: Seemingly Ordinary Resident
steps.text: But it's not like they need anyone's permission for that. They might as well take a meeting with a Catastrophe.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: If Catastrophes could speak, maybe we wouldn't need to fight each other.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: ...it's just like you said, Mr. Rat King.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: It's Lungmen. Lungmen's got its own rules Wei Yenwu agreed to a decade ago. We ain't about to go breakin' 'em.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: But you're the executive. That's why we're here to pay our respects.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...You want to wipe out Penguin Logistics, and take their place.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Exactly.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You don't know much about them, Sicilians. This deal would not be of benefit to you.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: (Gambino!)

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Are you tryin' to tell us we can't win? Mr. 'Rat King'?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Winning and losing are words that have no place in a business discussion. No wonder you had to flee Siracusa. You are no match for that woman.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You insult the Family?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Quiet, Gambino! We're after Penguin Logistics here...

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You need only follow the rules. I am not here to protect Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Penguin Logistics is on its face a legal entity. The only thing that can protect it is the ironclad law of Lungmen.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But they do, from time to time, cause offense to various stakeholders. And they never take it appropriately seriously.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But bear in mind, Sicilians, you must never overstep your bounds.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: An unconventional order is not the same as disorder. Siracusans should understand this more than anyone. But you must never again bring trouble to these old bones of mine. Promise me that.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: ...I understand.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: There are so many more stars in Lungmen this time of year. So many more than you'd think.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: The tea on the table has gone cold, hasn't it?

steps.name: Passerby
steps.text: This is Uncle's... Hey, we're on the clock.

steps.name: Passerby
steps.text: I'm not deaf. I'm on it. Once I'm done let's go get tea.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Looks like it's our turn.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: We paid our respects, put down our crossbows, and made sure not to hurt any civilians.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: ...all nice and proper-like under the new rules.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: So we're surrounded? Six or so deep on all sides?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh, like a roll cake?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: The Rat King is the boss of the slums. Of course his claws and teeth are everywhere.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Why didn't you say so earlier?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I thought he was just an urban legend. And I never imagined he'd actually be a rat. Who would take a nickname like that?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: With all them people around, it's too hard to tell who's after us and who's a passerby!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: We don't have a lot of room to act here.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: What do we do?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You're always asking what to do. Don't you ever think for yourself?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Here they come.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Here you are. I think you can make out the situation from up here.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Your friends are locked in a life or death struggle. Aren't you going to help them?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: From what I've heard of you, I never thought you'd be so heavy handed.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I don't share every last thought of mine with the young people.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Sure enough. I always forget what kind of person you are.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Many have forgotten as much. And they all ended up six feet deep in an unmarked grave. You're already among the luckiest.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You killed the boss. You think that'll just blow over?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Heh heh. It's all very clear to me.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: The owner of Penguin Logistics has always acted so prideful, as if above everyone else. But Lungmen is changing. She cannot allow this to continue.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: They needed to be taught a lesson. And a very harsh one at that.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: There's always a comeuppance when you bite the hand that feeds.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You've done so much with the help of Penguin Logistics...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Wait, were you planning this from the very beginning?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Who knows?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Couldn't be. Your whole act is way too good. Or, at least it's better than mine.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Heh heh... you really are impressively clever.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: The flames react to your will. Will you put me in the ground tonight?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: How could I?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I respect my elders, and care for the young.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Mostima!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Woah, Exusiai! We're the ones who are surrounded. Don't break formation!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hold on! I'm coming!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: They're all mixed in with the normal folk. This ain't no way to fight!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: What is going on...?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Bison, don't just sit there like a bump on a log. Yer in my way! Move it!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: They're all... it's all... how can I...?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...I can't.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: All right. If that's how it has to be, we'll do it their way.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Can you hear me?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: A message? For who?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Careful.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Focus, Sora.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: O- okay!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: You're here, aren't you? You always have been.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Young Master... I...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I don't blame you. I'm sure it was all my father's machinations. But right here, right now, I need you to help me.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: ...Of course. Give me your instructions, Young Master.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: You really think this is a time for instructions?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Just send them flying.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: To hear such an order from the mouth of the Young Master...

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Allow me to advocate for the Master of the House and ask: why?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Who gives a shit why? Out of my way, Croissant!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ooh...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Haaagh!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: He- he knocked 'em into the air?!  That ain't how I do things!

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Hm... the Master of the House should be pleased with this result. But should the Young Master continue in this way... I worry he may find himself corrupted by Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: No... I mustn't obstruct the Young Master any further. If this is the course he believes is correct, then so be it.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: You little punk! I'll put you in the ground!

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: He dodged?!

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Yowch! Something knocked my club away!

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Careful, they got a sniper!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Outta my way!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: ...the intensity is under control, but you haven't moved a single step. Isn't that a little unreasonable?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: When one stands unmoving, that does not mean one is relaxed.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Is there anything in Lungmen that can defeat you?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Yes. 'Lungmen' can.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Ooh, what a crafty answer.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I go to the park to exercise, every morning, without fail. It's important to stay active as I get older.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: And are these morning exercises effective?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You have to add in a bit of life experience.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: How are the two Siracusans?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: How are they indeed.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: ...I really wonder how many of these invisible problems you quietly solve each and every day.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: How many times have you tricked these people into massacring each other rather than let them dip their toes into Lungmen?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I don't recall. All I can tell you is that regardless of how many corpses piled up in the sewers, there are always far more people who strive to survive.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Mostima! I'm here to——

steps.name: Seemingly Ordinary Resident
steps.text: That's far enough. You guys, go help the Dai Lo.

steps.name: Mafioso & Passerby
steps.text: Right!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: You won't get away with this.

steps.name: Seemingly Ordinary Resident
steps.text: A sniper? The princeling's bodyguard?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Outta my way!

steps.name: Seemingly Ordinary Resident
steps.text: You're just a regular Messenger. You don't belong here.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Messenger? That's right, I'm a Messenger. But the ladies behind me and in front of me, making all that noise? They're Messengers too.

steps.name: Seemingly Ordinary Resident
steps.text: You're not like Texas and the others. You should leave this battle. Get yourself home safe.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...you done?

steps.name: Seemingly Ordinary Resident
steps.text: Nng——! You have some fight in you!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Just do it!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Right!
